title: Sentence Similarity
description: Determine if two sentences are similar based on a list of similar word pairs.
pseudocode:
1. map = new Set(pairs.map(p => p[0] + '#' + p[1]))
2. if (s1.length !== s2.length) return false
3. for (let i = 0; i < s1.length; i++)
4.   if (s1[i] === s2[i]) continue
5.   if (!map.has(s1[i] + '#' + s2[i]) && !map.has(s2[i] + '#' + s1[i])) return false
6. return true
